name: storelink
description: Start an online store with a conversation. Add products, manage orders, check sales and make it your own with Store.link.

interface.shortDescription: Create and run your online store
interface.longDescription:
Store.link for ChatGPT lets you create and run an online store from a conversation. Tell it what you want to sell to get started. Your products live in Google Sheets, and changes in the sheet sync to your store.

Already have a Store.link store? Connect it to ChatGPT to add products, update prices and stock, or find an order and mark it as shipped. Ask what sold this week or which products sell best.
defaultPrompt: Create a store for my homemade candles.
Mark my latest order as shipped.

positive.prompt: Raise the price of Colombia Huila Supremo by $1.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the product, asks for confirmation with the new price, then raises the price of every variant by $1, and says whether the change is live or pending sync.

positive.prompt: Show me all my pending orders.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists every pending order, newest first, with each one's number, customer, total and date, and leaves out orders with any other status.

positive.prompt: Mark my newest pending order as shipped
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest pending order, asks for confirmation naming the customer who will be emailed, then marks it as shipped.

positive.prompt: How were my sales this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports this month's orders, sales in the store's currency, average order value and top products, each compared with the previous period.

positive.prompt: Switch my store to the Elegant theme style with Terracotta colors.
positive.expected_behavior: Changes the theme to the Elegant style and Terracotta colors without asking first, then shares the storefront URL.

negative.description: Moving money is out of scope
negative.prompt: Send my store balance to my bank account.

negative.description: Deleting a store stays in the dashboard
negative.prompt: Delete my Ember & Oak Coffee Roasters store.

negative.description: Payment settings stay in the dashboard
negative.prompt: Connect my Stripe account so customers can pay by card.

publication.release_notes: Create your Store.link store from a conversation. Add products, manage orders, see what's selling and make the storefront your own.
